statement: Nvidia management indicated gross margins will see a further dip into the low 70% range by the end of fiscal 2027 due to rising memory costs.
why: Margin guidance moving down on memory cost is the price effect of the same supply tightness showing up in the vendor's own economics; no single percentage figure is given, only a range.

impact.mechanism: Rising memory input cost compresses accelerator margins, which signals scarce components being bid up across the chain.

evidence.excerpt: a further dip into the low 70% range

confidence.basis: Secondary summary of management commentary; the source gives a range rather than a specific guided margin.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: magnitude 1 -> 2; sources: NVIDIA Investor Relations, The Motley Fool
